sketchMechanisms: The `object` declaration creates a singleton — exactly one instance can ever exist, and it is created lazily only when first accessed.
A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no matching row exists on the right — unmatched columns fill with NULL.
In Lua, tables are the only data structure; a metatable's `__index` field lets a table defer lookups it cannot resolve to a parent — and that chain can be circular or end in `nil`.
